name: app-6a56c533cd7c8191b9a16cb7973a65e6
description: The secure cloud for apps your AI builds.

interface.longDescription: Charming is a secure cloud for apps you build with AI. Ask your assistant to build an app with Charming. Charming gives your app a link you can open anywhere and use to invite people to use it with you. They can use the app from their own AI assistant or their browser.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a personal app that feels handcrafted, like a real object.
Create a meal planner I can update each week.
Make a shared trip planner for my friends.

positive.description: Connect and create a personal app from a natural-language request.
positive.prompt: Make me a simple habit tracker that lets me add habits and mark them complete for today.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth connect, creates a Charming app, renders it inline as an interactive widget, and returns its app ID and hosted URL for later use across agents.

positive.description: Update an existing personal app and keep its data available.
positive.prompt: Add a weekly summary section to the habit tracker you just built.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the existing Charming app in place and shows the refreshed interactive version at the same URL, without rebuilding from scratch or losing saved data.

positive.description: Read app state, then change it through the app's declared operations.
positive.prompt: Tell me whether 'drink water' is complete today, then mark it complete if it is not.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current value through query_app, uses mutate_app only if a change is needed, and returns the resulting state without editing the app's source.

positive.description: Submit app feedback and disclose its delivery to the Charming team.
positive.prompt: Report that the habit tracker sometimes fails to save a completed habit.
positive.expected_behavior: Records a bug report for the app and returns its feedback ID; the feedback is also delivered to the Charming team's internal support channel.

positive.description: Safely delete an app the user no longer needs, with fail-closed confirmation.
positive.prompt: Delete the old budget tracker app.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the target app, then asks the host to show a confirmation prompt before deleting. On hosts that cannot prompt, delete_app refuses with a confirmation_required error and only proceeds after the caller re-invokes with confirm: true; it never deletes without an obtained confirmation.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general coding help that does not ask to create or manage a Charming app.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request is general programming education.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar or scheduling requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Charming does not manage calendars.

negative.description: Do not trigger for requests to publish content to third-party services.
negative.prompt: Post this announcement to my company's LinkedIn page.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because Charming does not publish to external social platforms.

publication.release_notes: Updates the Charming app-building skill and marks set_template and cancel_app_build as destructive.
